recognize_zh: 四格骨髓抹片中可見大型、染色質呈篩網狀的巨母紅血球（megaloblast）、有絲分裂像、巨大後髓細胞與巨大帶狀核（giant metamyelocyte/band），以及核分葉過多的巨核細胞，三系皆有巨母細胞變化，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Large erythroid precursors with open, finely stippled sieve-like chromatin and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm (megaloblasts)
Mitotic figure in an erythroid precursor (panel A)
Giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms with large, loosely structured horseshoe-shaped nuclei (panels B-D)
Megakaryocyte with hyperlobulated, fragmented-appearing nucleus (panel C)
Hypercellular marrow fields with orthochromatic erythroblasts and a Howell-Jolly body-type inclusion (panel B)
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (four panels) shows hypercellular marrow with megaloblastic change affecting multiple lineages. Erythroid precursors are enlarged with finely stippled, open chromatin and nucleocytoplasmic asynchrony, and a mitotic figure is present. Granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant bands with large, open horseshoe-shaped nuclei, and a megakaryocyte shows nuclear hyperlobulation. No increase in blasts is evident in these fields. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia; correlation with serum vitamin B12 and folate levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS lacks vitamin deficiency and typically shows hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes and hypogranular pseudo-Pelger neutrophils rather than giant metamyelocytes.
Methotrexate, hydroxyurea, azathioprine or antiretrovirals produce identical morphology and are distinguished only by medication history and normal B12/folate.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Leukemia shows increased blasts or proerythroblasts rather than orderly maturation with giant myeloid precursors.
